_about: Drinks that are not on the IBA list but a working bar serves constantly. Specs follow the US bartending-school and bar-management standard rather than any single author's house recipe. Every entry cites what it was checked against and states where it departs.
_pour_standard: US standard pour: one shot = 1.5 oz (45 ml). Highball / single-mixer drink = one shot built over ice and filled with mixer, roughly 1:4 (Barnard College Bartending Course study guide; WebstaurantStore bar guide gives 1.5 oz as the 3-count standard for single-mixer cocktails and 2 oz as the 4-count for neat or rocks; TIPS gives 1.5 oz as the standard US shot). Up and stirred drinks = 2 oz base, matching the IBA Dry Martini (60 ml). Sours = 2 oz base, 3/4 oz citrus, 3/4 oz sweet (Williams College mixology course notes). Difford's Guide is cited as a secondary check; its 50-60 ml pours are UK measures and run heavy for a US bar.

drinks.name: Gin & Tonic
drinks.method: Build over ice: one shot of gin, fill with chilled tonic, stir once.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 1 shot gin, tonic to fill, lime
Difford's Guide, Gin & Tonic #835 (50 ml : 120 ml)

drinks.deviation: None from the course standard.

drinks.name: Vodka Soda
drinks.method: Build over ice, fill with soda, stir lightly to keep the fizz.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: highball rule, 1 shot and fill
Difford's Guide, Vodka Soda #4280 (60 ml : 150 ml, lemon)

drinks.deviation: Difford's pours 2 oz; card uses the US shot.

drinks.name: Vodka Tonic
drinks.method: Build over ice, fill with tonic, stir once.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 1 shot vodka, tonic to fill, lime

drinks.deviation: None.

drinks.name: Rum & Coke
drinks.method:
Build over ice, fill with cola, stir once.
Note:
With a squeezed lime wedge it is a Cuba Libre (IBA).

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 1 shot rum, Coke to fill, lime
Difford's Guide, Cuba Libre #495

drinks.deviation: None from the course standard.

drinks.name: Whiskey Ginger

Build over ice, fill with ginger ale, stir once.
Note:
Seven & Seven: Seagram's 7 and 7UP, same build.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 1 shot whiskey, ginger ale, lemon twist
Whisky Advocate, Whiskey Ginger (1½ oz, top)

drinks.deviation: None.

drinks.name: Whiskey & Coke
drinks.method: Build over ice, fill with cola, stir once.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: highball rule, 1 shot and fill

drinks.deviation: Not listed by name in the course; built on its highball rule.

drinks.name: Scotch & Soda
drinks.method: Build over ice, fill with soda, stir once. Same build for any whiskey highball.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 1 shot scotch, soda
Difford's Guide, Scotch Whisky Highball #4794 (45 ml : 90 ml)

drinks.deviation: None.

drinks.name: Screwdriver
drinks.method: Build over ice, fill with orange juice, stir.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 1 shot vodka, OJ to fill
Difford's Guide, Screwdriver #1762

drinks.deviation: Course lists no garnish; the orange slice is common and optional.

drinks.name: Vodka Cranberry
drinks.method:
Build over ice, fill with cranberry, stir.
Note:
Cape Codder is the same drink. Add pineapple for a Bay Breeze, orange for a Madras.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: Cape Codder, 1 shot vodka, ½ oz lime, cranberry to fill, lime
Difford's Guide, Cape Codder #368

drinks.deviation: None.

drinks.name: Greyhound
drinks.method:
Build over ice, fill with grapefruit juice, stir.
Note:
Salt the rim and it is a Salty Dog.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 1 shot vodka, grapefruit to fill
Difford's Guide, Salty Dog #1735

drinks.deviation: None.

drinks.name: Tom Collins
drinks.method: Shake gin, lemon and syrup with ice. Strain into an ice-filled Collins glass, top with soda, stir briefly.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 2 oz gin, ½ oz lemon, 1 tsp sugar, soda, cherry
Difford's Guide, Tom Collins #1972 (52.5 : 22.5 : 15 ml)

drinks.deviation: Card uses the highball shot (1½ oz) with Difford's lemon and syrup proportions; the course pours 2 oz with less citrus.

drinks.name: Wine Spritzer
drinks.method: Build in the glass, ice optional, stir gently.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 3 oz white wine, 1 oz club soda, lemon twist, ice optional
Difford's Guide, Spritzer #1862

drinks.deviation: None.

drinks.name: Vodka Martini
drinks.method:
Stir with ice until very cold. Strain into a chilled glass. Shaken on request.
Note:
Dry: a rinse or ¼ oz. Wet: ½ oz or more. Dirty: add ½ oz olive brine.

refs.label: IBA, Dry Martini (60 ml gin : 10 ml dry vermouth)
Barnard bartending course: 2 oz vodka, 1 tsp dry vermouth

drinks.deviation: Uses the IBA Dry Martini ratio with vodka; the course teaches drier (1 tsp).

drinks.name: Dirty Martini
drinks.method:
Stir with ice until very cold. Strain into a chilled glass.
Note:
Extra dirty: ¾ oz brine.
drinks.garnish: Two or three skewered green olives.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 2 oz gin or vodka, 1 tsp dry vermouth, 2 tsp olive brine, olives
Difford's Guide, Dirty Martini #650 (60 : 22.5 : 15 ml)

drinks.deviation: Between the two references on vermouth and brine.

drinks.name: Gimlet
ingredients: Fresh version: ¾ oz lime juice + ½ oz simple syrup
drinks.method:
Shake with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe, or over ice in a rocks glass.
Note:
Vodka Gimlet: 2 oz vodka.

refs.label: Barnard bartending course: 2 oz gin, ½ oz Rose's lime, lime garnish
Difford's Guide, Gimlet #831

drinks.deviation: Course spec, with the fresh-lime build added as the modern alternative.

drinks.name: Amaretto Sour
drinks.method: Dry shake, then shake with ice. Strain over fresh ice.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Amaretto Sour #53 (2 : 1 amaretto to lemon)
Barnard bartending course: 2 oz amaretto, ½ oz lime

drinks.deviation: Difford's 2:1 ratio at the 1½ oz shot; course uses lime and no egg white.

drinks.name: Scotch Sour
drinks.method: Dry shake, then shake with ice. Strain over fresh ice.

refs.label: Williams College mixology notes: sour template 2 : ¾ : ¾
Difford's Guide, Scotch Sour #2848 (60 : 30 : 20 ml)

drinks.deviation: Standard sour template; Difford's runs slightly more sour.

drinks.name: Kamikaze
drinks.method: Shake with ice. Strain into a chilled shot glass; scale to 1½ : ¾ : ¾ for a rocks serve.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Kamikaze #1087 (1 : ½ : ½)
Barnard bartending course: 1 shot vodka, 1 oz triple sec, ½ oz Rose's lime, rocks

drinks.deviation: Difford's proportions; course version is sweeter and served down.

drinks.name: Hot Toddy
drinks.method: Pre-warm the glass. Add whiskey, honey and lemon, top with hot water, stir until the honey dissolves.
drinks.garnish: Lemon wheel studded with cloves, cinnamon stick.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Hot Toddy #987

drinks.deviation: Difford's: 45 ml Scotch, 7.5 ml lemon, 7.5 ml honey syrup, 5 ml rich syrup, cloves, 60 ml water. Card is the longer US serve at the standard shot.

drinks.name: Negroni Sbagliato
drinks.method: Build over ice, prosecco last. Stir briefly.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Negroni Sbagliato #2515

drinks.deviation: None.

drinks.name: Milano Torino
drinks.method:
Stir with ice. Strain over a large cube.
Note:
Top with soda and it is an Americano; swap soda for gin and it is a Negroni.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Milano Torino #3495

drinks.deviation: None.

drinks.name: Bamboo
drinks.method: Stir with ice. Strain into a chilled glass.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Bamboo (Boothby 1908, equal parts) #4151
Difford's Guide, Bamboo classic recipe #18976

drinks.deviation: Equal-parts 1908 form; Difford's own recipe is sherry-heavy (60 : 20 ml).

drinks.name: Mezcal Margarita
drinks.method: Shake with ice. Fine strain over fresh ice. Salt rim optional.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Mezcal Margarita #2497

drinks.deviation: Difford's quantities; its saline and bitters omitted.

drinks.name: East 8 Hold-up
drinks.method:
Shake with ice. Strain over fresh ice.
Note:
Kevin Armstrong, Milk & Honey London. Sources date it 2006 (CLASS) or 2010 (Difford's).

refs.label: Difford's Guide, East 8 Hold-up #3519
CLASS magazine, Modern classics: East 8 Hold-Up

drinks.deviation: None; Difford's quantities (45 / 15 / 20 / 15 / 7.5 / 5 ml).

drinks.name: Shirley Temple
drinks.method:
Build over ice, grenadine first, fill with ginger ale, stir once.
Note:
Add 1½ oz vodka for a Dirty Shirley.
drinks.garnish: Maraschino cherry, lemon or orange wheel.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Shirley Temple #1817 (7.5 ml grenadine, 10 ml lemon, 165 ml ginger ale)
Difford's Guide, Dirty Shirley #15826

drinks.deviation: Difford's lemon juice omitted; the US serve is grenadine and ginger ale (or lemon-lime soda).

drinks.name: Roy Rogers
drinks.method: Build over ice, grenadine first, fill with cola, stir once.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Roy Rogers #1700 (7.5 ml grenadine, cola, lime wedge)

drinks.deviation: Cherry garnish instead of Difford's lime wedge.

drinks.name: Arnold Palmer
drinks.method:
Build over ice, stir.
Note:
Add 1½ oz vodka for a John Daly.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Arnold Palmer #2142

drinks.deviation: Difford's builds it from tea, lemon juice, syrup and soda. Card is the half-and-half tea and lemonade served in the US.

drinks.name: Virgin Mojito
ingredients: 2 tsp Sugar or ½ oz simple syrup
drinks.method:
Gently press the mint with lime and sugar in the glass. Fill with crushed ice, top with soda, stir.
Note:
Also ordered as a Nojito.
drinks.garnish: Mint sprig and a lime wedge.

refs.label: IBA, Mojito (base recipe minus the 45 ml rum)

drinks.deviation: The IBA Mojito without rum; no codified virgin version exists.

drinks.name: Virgin Mary
drinks.method:
Roll with ice between two glasses, or stir. Strain into an ice-filled glass.
Note:
Also called a Bloody Shame.
drinks.garnish: Celery stalk and a lemon wedge.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Virgin Mary #252

drinks.deviation: Difford's quantities; its half barspoon of horseradish left to the bar.

drinks.name: Lemon, Lime & Bitters
drinks.method:
Build over ice, bitters dashed on top.
Note:
Soda & Bitters: same with soda water. Bitters are 44% ABV but four dashes is about 1 ml; mention it to a strictly abstaining guest.

refs.label: Difford's Guide, Lemon Lime & Bitters #2466

drinks.deviation: None.

drinks.name: Zero-Proof Spritz
drinks.method: Build over ice in a wine glass, stir once.

refs.label: IBA, Spritz (60 ml Aperol, 90 ml prosecco, splash soda)

drinks.deviation: The IBA Spritz with NA substitutes; no codified zero-proof version exists.

drinks.name: Bootleg
drinks.method:
Build over ice, soda last. Stir.
Note:
*Bootleg mix: blend simple syrup, water, fresh lime juice and a large handful of mint until smooth. Minnesota's Prohibition-era club drink; its inventor is unknown and several clubs claim it.
drinks.garnish: Lime slice and a mint sprig.

refs.label: Lunds & Byerlys, The Bootleg Cocktail: A Minnesota Tradition (2 : 2 : 2 oz)
Artful Living, Bootleg recipe

drinks.deviation: Equal parts per Lunds & Byerlys. Artful Living's mix uses frozen lemonade and limeade concentrate; either mix works. Folk drink, no canonical spec, and the 2 oz pour is the drink's own convention, not the house shot.
